name: pi-telegram-tts-minimax
description: TTS orchestrator for the Pi coding agent + @llblab/pi-telegram bridge. Registers a `TelegramVoiceSynthesisProvider` with the bridge; delegates to a peer-dep TtsProvider (selected via extensions['pi-telegram-tts-minimax'].tts_provider in telegram.json). The TtsProvider contract and globalThis-backed registry live in `./tts-provider.ts`; provider packages (`pi-openai-tts`, `pi-minimax-tts`) implement it.
